name: @jini-ai/plugins
description: Reserved for Jini's own host-extension plugin format (./host — manifest + setup() + hooks + activation), not yet implemented; the only working implementation of that concept today is Tovu's src/features/plugin-runtime/ (SPEC-005), which has not moved here. The third-party Agent Plugins open standard support and bundled plugins that used to live under this package's ./agent-plugins subpath moved out on 2026-08-18 to @jini-ai/agent-plugins — see that package for ui-ux-design, create-tovu-theme, or anything Agent-Plugins-spec related.
